local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local elapsed=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<1 then return end;elapsed=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during Retort route inspection')
 local target=nil
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.items) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0xc4f) then target=obj;break end end
 if not target then print('RetortRoute target absent');return end
 print('RetortRoute apparatus type API present='..tostring(types.ESM4Apparatus~=nil))
 print('RetortRoute target original=true player='..tostring(self.position)..' target='..tostring(target.position))
 local bounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self)
 local flags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.OpenDoor+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.UsePathgrid
 local offsets={{util.vector3(0,0,0),util.vector3(100,0,0),util.vector3(-100,0,0),util.vector3(0,100,0),util.vector3(0,-100,0)}}
 for i,offset in ipairs(offsets) do
  local dest=nearby.findNearestNavMeshPosition(target.position+offset,{{agentBounds=bounds,includeFlags=flags,searchAreaHalfExtents=util.vector3(80,80,256)}})
  if dest then
   local status,path=nearby.findPath(self.position,dest,{{agentBounds=bounds,includeFlags=flags,destinationTolerance=64}})
   print('RetortRoute candidate='..i..' status='..tostring(status)..' count='..#path..' destination='..tostring(dest))
   if status==nearby.FIND_PATH_STATUS.Success and #path>0 then
    for n,point in ipairs(path) do print('RetortRoute waypoint='..n..' position='..tostring(point)) end
    print('RetortRoute ordinary navigation ready');return
   end
  else print('RetortRoute candidate='..i..' no nearest navigation position') end
 end
end}}}}
